White people can’t perform telekinesis for the same reason people of any race can’t: there’s no reliable scientific evidence that humans can move objects with their minds. Telekinesis is a fictional or paranormal concept, and alleged demonstrations haven’t held up under controlled testing. Race has no bearing on it.
